verdict.rationale: Skills can be invoked headlessly via the Messages/Skills API (container parameter, skill_id) and via the Claude Agent SDK for building production agents, which supports non-interactive/automated use outside the interactive CLI. However, there's no explicit CI/pipeline example, and community reports note skills are sometimes inconsistently triggered even in interactive use, raising doubts about reliability in unattended automation. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/automation example or tutorial, independent verification of reliable headless triggering, and confirmation that skill invocation works deterministically without human-in-the-loop prompting.
